{"id":1993815714,"question_id":4291,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1777779271,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1993815714/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Cost to Move Between Indices","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n    vector<int> minCost(vector<int>& nums, vector<vector<int>>& queries) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        vector<int>ans;\n        vector<ll>leftcost(n , 0);\n        vector<ll>rightcost(n , 0);\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n-1 ; i++){\n            ll cost = 0;\n            if(i == 0) cost = 1;\n            else {\n                ll leftdist = (ll)nums[i] - nums[i-1];\n                ll rightdist = (ll)nums[i+1] - nums[i];\n\n                if(rightdist < leftdist) cost = 1;\n                else cost = rightdist;\n            }\n            rightcost[i+1] = rightcost[i] + cost;\n        }\n        \n\n        for(auto it : leftcost) cout<<it<<\" \";\n        cout<<endl;\n        for(auto it : rightcost) cout<<it<<\" \";\n\n        return ans;\n        \n        \n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-cost-to-move-between-indices","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1967}
